answer: Proof of space mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to allocate dedicated physical drive sectors to cryptographic plotting. Whether relaying telemetry on a factory plume, wild yarrow growth, or copper smelting, peers verify identity via low-latency plot read challenges. An attacker incurs the concrete capital cost of provisioning dedicated non-volatile storage per alias. However, this mechanism favors entities with vast disk arrays and excludes storage-limited edge agents.
